claims.text: Kasten snapshots apps on Kubernetes PVs and exports to storage locations incl. Veeam repositories, with primary location such as object storage or NFS
Helm options include genericStorageBackup.token, Generic Volume Snapshot restore pod resources, and sidecar injection webhook with selectors

A.notes: Declines to answer the NFS/no-CSI question.

claims.text: Kasten supports GSB for storage with no CSI drivers, so NFS volumes can be protected
Kasten does not recommend GSB for storage without CSI drivers
Most NFS storage services lack a CSI driver with snapshot and clone capabilities
Kasten recommends migrating persistent data from NFS to storage with a CSI driver with snapshot/clone
Recommends existing customers migrate to a CSI driver with snapshot and clone capabilities
Kasten requires a CSI driver with Volume Snapshot support

B.notes: [2] and [4] point to a Multi-Cluster best-practices passage that says nothing about GSB; GSB file-copy migration aid not mentioned.

claims.text: Command veeamconfig schedule activefull set --jobname ... --monthlyweekday Mon --weeknumber Second --months Jan,Jul
--weeknumber accepts First, Second, Third, Fourth or Last; --monthlyweekday sets weekday; --months lists months
If --months omitted, active full created every month
--thisday 21 --months Jan,Jul creates active full on day 21 of Jan and Jul
Veeam Agent for IBM AIX supports configuring Active Full schedule via CLI
veeamconfig configures the active full backup schedule
Monthly schedule allows specifying day of month and months
Monthly schedule is described by day of month, not weekday occurrence

B.notes: Misses the --monthlyweekday/--weeknumber option and wrongly says the omitted-months behaviour is not documented although its own source [1] states it.
